task: MACE-MP-0 Foundation Model Reproduction and Analysis
scientific_goal: Develop and validate a universal foundation model for atomistic simulations covering the periodic table with ab initio accuracy after fine-tuning on minimal task-specific data
architecture: MACE (Higher Order Equivariant Message Passing Neural Networks)
training_data: MPtrj dataset (~1.5 million inorganic crystal structures from Materials Project)

experiments.name: Water RDF Simulation
experiments.description: Liquid water structure validation via radial distribution function
experiments.system: 32 H2O molecules in 12 A cubic box at 330 K

experiments.name: Adsorption Energy Scaling Relations
experiments.description: Scaling relations for O* and OH* adsorption on fcc(111) transition metal surfaces

experiments.name: Reaction Barrier Comparison
experiments.description: CRBH20 reaction barrier validation for organic reactions

validation_approach: Reproduce three key benchmark tests using structural parameters from the reproduction dataset, compare against DFT reference values
